seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Jev returns decisions (one probability per option) in a single forward pass instead of generating text/tokens; enables parallel fan-out of 50+ sub-tasks for planning/verification/safety in agents, shifting from serial Chain-of-Thought to wider parallel scheduling.
Harness choice has little impact on task success rate but significantly affects cost; simple harnesses can compete with or beat native ones like Claude Code.
Managing auth in multiplayer channels (e.g., Slack) is the hardest part of enterprise AI vs personal AI; critical for managed deep agents.
